stories.headline: England end Spain's record 43-match unbeaten run
stories.summary: England beat Spain 3–2 in the group stage of UEFA Nations League A. The result ended Spain's 43-match unbeaten streak, the longest ever put together by a national team.

stories.headline: Mirra Andreeva wins the WTA Finals on her debut
stories.summary: Mirra Andreeva beat Elina Svitolina 7–5, 6–3 to win the women's singles title at the WTA Finals, played on outdoor hard courts at Indian Wells, California. She was the youngest champion since Maria Sharapova in 2004, and the first to take the title on her tournament debut since Ashleigh Barty in 2019.

stories.headline: A fanfiction archive comes back after weeks offline
stories.summary: Archive of Our Own, a nonprofit repository for fanfiction, went down on 29 October 2026 after a security incident. Its volunteers warned that the work might take two to four weeks. The site was restored to limited functionality 17 days after the attack.

stories.headline: One deep-sea rock sheltered 245 tiny animals
stories.summary: Researchers opened 244 fist-sized rocks called polymetallic nodules, gathered from the Clarion-Clipperton Zone in the central Pacific Ocean, and found 4,139 small animals in their cracks. Each nodule held 17 animals on average, but one held 245. The nodules are made largely of iron and manganese oxides and grow by only a few millimetres over a million years.
